query:
INSERT INTO keypairs (account_id, uri, type, public_key, created_at, updated_at)
                   VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), now())
                   ON CONFLICT (uri) DO UPDATE
                     SET account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id,
                         type = EXCLUDED.type,
                         public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key,
                         updated_at = now()
